ThingDef.label: terraplate armor
ThingDef.description: A set of organic armor, shaped in a specialized Terravat from specific materials. Despite being a plant that's been molded into a shell, Terraplate's carefull engineering allows it to almost rival traditional marine armor. Growing even one set takes significant resources, but completely circumvents the needs for high-tech fabrication in order to aquire armor that can withstand many threats. Terraplate armor requires several ingredients: primwood and terramass for primary and flexible materials, endosap to reinforce the armored areas, and finally, a fresh corpse to help 'shape' the armor. Thankfully this acommendates all body sizes, and the armor will adapt to anything of similar size... though getting into the armor might be a bit tedious for all. The armor is quite strong, but suffers from the same weaknesses as all prima creations: flammability, a limited lifespan, and piercing resistance. It cannot be infused.

ThingDef.label: terraplate helmet
ThingDef.description: A helmet that is intended to be grown (and worn) alongside Terraplate armor. Due to the armor being fully formed before being worn, the helmet has to be grown seperately, otherwise... well, how would you get in?
